pages.title: Beach Clean-Up Volunteer Sign-Up
pages.html:
🌊 Beach Guardians

Beach Clean-Up Volunteer Sign-Up

Join us on Saturday, April 12th to make a real difference. Help us restore our beautiful coastline and protect marine life. No experience needed—just bring your passion!

Event Details

📅 When

Date: Saturday, April 12, 2025

Time: 9:00 AM – 12:30 PM

Check-in: 8:30 AM

📍 Where

Location: Crescent Bay Beach

123 Shoreline Drive, Coastal City, CA 90210

Parking: Free lot available near the main entrance

👥 What to Expect

Work alongside other volunteers to remove debris, plastic, and litter from the beach. We'll provide all tools and organize by team. Light refreshments included!

💚 Impact

Last year we collected over 2 tons of trash and saved countless animals. Your help protects the marine ecosystem and keeps our beach beautiful for everyone.

What to Bring

  • Closed-toe shoes: Wear sturdy, water-resistant shoes for the sandy, rocky beach
  • Sun protection: Bring sunscreen (SPF 30+), a hat, and sunglasses
  • Reusable water bottle: Stay hydrated! We'll have water stations, but bring your own if you prefer
  • Work gloves (optional): We provide gloves, but bring your own if you prefer a specific fit
  • Light layers: Morning ocean breezes can be cool; bring a light jacket
  • Sense of humor: Cleaning up is hard work, but it's way more fun with a smile!

Why Volunteer With Us?

Make Real Impact

Directly contribute to environmental conservation and ocean health. Every piece of trash removed is one less threat to marine life.

Community Connection

Meet like-minded people who care about the environment. Build friendships while doing meaningful work together.

Free T-Shirt & Snacks

All volunteers receive a limited-edition Beach Guardians t-shirt and enjoy complimentary refreshments and light snacks after the event.

Service Hours

Perfect for students, career changers, or anyone needing volunteer hours. We provide certificates of participation.

Learn & Share

Hear from marine biologists about ocean conservation. Take photos and share your impact on social media—tag us!

No Experience Needed

From kids to seniors, everyone can help. Our team leaders will guide you through every step. Just show up and be ready to make a difference!

Sign Up Now

Register below to secure your spot. We cap volunteers at 150 to ensure a safe, organized event. Sign up today!

Thank you for signing up! You'll receive a confirmation email with parking details and day-of instructions within 24 hours.

Beach Guardians Clean-Up Initiative

Phone: (555) 234-5678 | Email: info@beachguardians.org

© 2025 Beach Guardians. Help us keep our shores clean.
